title: •Diversionary Tactics
caption: •Diversionary Tactics (V)
game_text:
USED: Target one piloted starship at a system. That starship is hyperspeed -1 for remainder of turn.
LOST: If you have two unique (•) piloted Rebel (or {icon:republic-square}) starfighters in battle at a system, draw destiny. Exclude one starship from that battle if destiny < 4.
lore: Rebel pilots understand that what they lack in numbers, they must make up for in strategy. They often use diversions to remove dangerous opponents from a conflict.
copyright: © 2001 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2001 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Banner USED OR LOST INTERRUPT (printed card is a Lost Interrupt). USED:/LOST: lines separated by \n. ODD ICON: the inline icon after 'Rebel (or' is a SQUARE silver tile with a grey Republic emblem (not the round silver crest of The Emperor/Mon Mothma (V)) — written {icon:republic} (stub: 'Republic'); the renderer may need a square Republic tile (probably the Republic starship/affiliation icon box). The slip leaves a small gap between the tile and ')' — icon padding, not typed. Margin credits: left 'Original concept by Thomas Caspersen', right 'Norwegian Nationals 2006'. Lore matches the scan. Only a 350 px scan; copyright Reflections III 2001 by set. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 350 px). Inline Republic icon: the square tile (Game Aid "Republic", Other Features), as the slip prints it; the round crest is "Character - Republic".
